name: Lighting & Emergency Lighting — wire to complete circuits, then fit, test and program

activities: structural fixing points and wall boxes
sequence.note: Fitting positions depend on ceiling/architectural coordination.

activities: cable pulling to fitting and switch/sensor positions
install emergency luminaires and exit signs
install occupancy/daylight sensors and DALI/addressable drivers
sequence.note: Final fix follows ceiling closure and decoration.

activities: terminate at DB / lighting control panel
lighting-control programming: scenes, sensors, daylight harvesting
central battery system test if applicable

typical_relationships.reason: fittings need coordinated, completed ceiling positions and fixings
luminaires connect to the roughed-in wiring at each position
lights cannot be switched or measured without a live board

typical_relationships.before: emergency luminaires installed, terminated and charged
typical_relationships.reason: the duration test requires installed fittings with fully charged batteries
programming needs the addressable devices physically present and commissioned
final fittings go in after finishes to avoid damage/rework

interfaces.requirement: lighting circuits are fed from a DB; testing requires that board energized
lighting wiring runs on installed containment/conduit
lighting-control and occupancy integration to the BMS
escape-route and emergency-lighting coordination with the evacuation strategy

testing_requirements: Insulation resistance and polarity of lighting circuits
commissioning_dependencies: Ceilings/architectural finishes ready for final fix
Emergency-lighting batteries given required charge period before discharge test
typical_exceptions: Exposed-services areas (no ceiling) mount fittings on containment/structure — different final-fix sequence
Self-contained emergency packs vs central-battery systems test differently
evidence: Luminaires were terminated and slated for lux testing before the feeding lighting board was energized, and the emergency-lighting discharge test was booked before the batteries had their required charge period.
